components.reason: Boards show only figures the engines compute; no score dial or outcome bars until a calculation produces them.
The Capital Eye shows the deterministic underwriting engine's results; AI writes the explanation and decides nothing.

The render is the hypothesis; survey, elevations and source records control the design.

components.reason: Quiet architecture: repair and flat modules first; nothing is added without the building problem it solves.

components.reason: The boards' phasing stays: envelope repair and leak detection first, HVAC next, density options last; no automation.

Adaptive reuse multifamily prototype that keeps the original façade, masonry and window rhythm.
Reuse eligibility is not a code approval; rooftop solar is an option, not a requirement.
Historic review stays required; no addition or density option is decided before identity, historic and code status and measured conditions.

claims.text: Envelope repair and leak detection cut water damage and unit downtime.
Targeted screens lower glare in the resident rooms that need them without losing daylight.
Plain work-order statuses shorten response times.
Step-free entry and an elevator are design requirements; compliance is confirmed by review, not claimed.
